name: Maximum Magic: Quirk of Destiny
source:
One day a castle fell from the sky and soon strange things began occurring around the area. The queen chose a young boy to investigate into it. While he is definitely smart and capable of great things, his personality is… well, a little off. He doesn’t follow orders well, doesn’t have common sense and likes playing tricks to scare people.

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2010/03/08/march-2010-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
